Author: Rin (original BeastHelper); Displeased edition
Name: Displeased BeastHelper
Description: Fork of Rin's BeastHelper (AGPL-3.0) with combat diagnostics, roster/whistle automation, First / Second Board score modes, First and Second Master's Board legendary profiles and Third Board three-beast clear mode with optional combat recovery and attack items. Entries, rewards and shops remain manual. Can be installed next to the official BeastHelper, but enable only one of them at a time. Commands: /dbh, /displeasedbeasthelper. Settings are stored separately (DispleasedBeastHelper.json).
Punchline: BeastHelper fork with Crucible board score / clear modes. Installs alongside the official BeastHelper.

Author: The Combat Reborn Team
Name: Displeased RSR - Board Score Assist
Description:
Displeased fork of Rotation Solver Reborn with Beastmaster Crucible board logic (gated to the Crucible). Replaces the official Rotation Solver Reborn (same InternalName and settings).

Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
Punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

Author: The Combat Reborn Team
Name: Displeased BMR - Crucible Assist
Description: Displeased fork of BossMod Reborn with Beastmaster Crucible board modules. Replaces the official BossMod Reborn (same InternalName and settings). Also includes local experimental solo BLU: Goldor clear and Resurrection through orb overlap and Guardian adds. Later transition requires live validation.
Punchline: Don't fail at raid mechanics anymore
